flawless: Hah! You fight like a Kjeldoran in summer: all armour and no fire.
Not one scratch on me. Go home and tell your hearth you met Balduvia.
The snows of Balduvia have hit me harder than you did.
solid: Good blows, stranger. Not enough of them, but good.
You drew blood. We will sing a short song about you.
close: By the ancestors, you nearly had me! Pass the mead, my hands are shaking.
Ha... ha! That was close enough to feel the frost spirits breathing down my neck.
